# Covered California

> > California's official health insurance marketplace offering Affordable Care Act plans, Medi-Cal enrollment, financial assistance through Premium Tax Credits, and small business coverage options.

Covered California helps California residents find and enroll in health insurance plans with financial help based on income. The site provides comprehensive support in multiple languages including Spanish and Korean, covering eligibility, enrollment periods, plan comparison, and employer mandate requirements.

## Key Topics

- Premium Tax Credit and Enhanced Premium Tax Credits
- Medi-Cal eligibility and coverage
- Affordable Care Act (ACA) compliance
- Covered California for Small Business (CCSB)
- Enrollment periods and special enrollment
- Financial assistance and cost-sharing reductions
- Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
- Employer Shared Responsibility mandate
- Preventive care benefits
- Income verification and documentation requirements
- Plan metal tiers (Gold, Silver, Bronze)
- Dental and vision insurance options
- HMO and PPO network types
- CCHIP (Covered California Health Insurance Plans)

## Enrollment and Eligibility

- [Special Enrollment Form](https://www.coveredca.com/special-enrollment/form): Special enrollment application form for qualifying life events
- [What is financial help?](https://www.coveredca.com/support/before-you-buy/what-is-financial-help): Premium Tax Credit and Enhanced Silver plan subsidies explained
- [How to Estimate Your Income](https://www.coveredca.com/support/financial-help/estimate-income): Guide to calculating household income for subsidy eligibility
- [Proof of Income](https://www.coveredca.com/documents-to-confirm-eligibility/income): Required income verification documents: W2, 1099, tax forms
- [People Under 30](https://www.coveredca.com/support/before-you-buy/people-under-30): Catastrophic plan options and coverage for young adults under 30

## Spanish Language Support (Español)

- [¿Quién puede obtener un plan de salud a través de Covered California?](https://www.coveredca.com/espanol/support/before-you-buy/who-is-eligible-covered-ca): Spanish: eligibility requirements for California residents and immigrants
- [Cómo aplicar](https://www.coveredca.com/espanol/support/getting-started/how-to-apply): Spanish: step-by-step enrollment process guide for Covered California
- [¿Qué es Medi-Cal?](https://www.coveredca.com/espanol/support/before-you-buy/what-is-medi-cal): Spanish: Medi-Cal program overview and eligibility information
- [Revisión de planes y precios](https://www.coveredca.com/espanol/support/getting-started/review-plans-and-prices): Spanish: plan comparison tool and HMO/PPO network types explained
- [Cómo apelar una decisión o presentar una queja](https://www.coveredca.com/espanol/support/file-an-appeal-or-complaint): Spanish: appeals process for eligibility decisions and complaints
- [¿Cuándo puedo aplicar con Covered California?](https://www.coveredca.com/espanol/support/before-you-buy/when-to-apply-covered-ca): Spanish: enrollment periods and when to apply for coverage
- [¿Cómo cancelo mi plan?](https://www.coveredca.com/espanol/support/membership/cancel-plan): Spanish: plan cancellation process and 14-day notice requirement
- [Asegúrate que tu visita de cuidado preventiva sea gratis con tu plan Gold](https://www.coveredca.com/espanol/support/getting-started/gold-copay-preventive-care-visit): Spanish: free preventive care visits with Gold plan explained

## Using Your Health Plan

- [Using My Plan](https://www.coveredca.com/support/using-my-plan): Support topics for using Covered California and Medi-Cal health plans
- [Children's Dental](https://www.coveredca.com/support/before-you-buy/childrens-dental): Pediatric dental coverage included in all health plans
- [Why isn't dental insurance for adults included in my health plan?](https://www.coveredca.com/support/before-you-buy/dental-insurance-adults): Adult dental coverage not included as essential health benefit
- [Vision Insurance](https://www.coveredca.com/support/before-you-buy/vision): Vision care options through VSP and EyeMed for adults and children

## Small Business Resources

- [CCSB Mandate](https://www.coveredca.com/forsmallbusiness/mandate): Employer Shared Responsibility mandate for small businesses under ACA

## Optional

- [중요한 변경 사항 (Korean: Important Changes)](https://www.coveredca.com/korean/important-changes): Korean: important policy changes and updates for 2026
- [Proof of Non-Incarcerated Status](https://www.coveredca.com/documents-to-confirm-eligibility/not-incarcerated): Documentation requirements to verify non-incarcerated status
